item.title: Adjectives in spare-room notices
item.explanation_text:
An adjective describes a person or thing. In a note about a spare room, you can use an adjective to show which thing you mean: the blue key, the small table, or the clean blanket. Put the adjective before the noun. In a phrase with a or an, put a or an first: a small table, an empty box. The next sound helps you choose: small starts with a consonant sound, and empty starts with a vowel sound.

You can also use an adjective after am, is, or are to describe the subject. Write “The key is blue” or “The towels are clean.” In a reply, you might write “I am ready.” The adjective has the same form with one thing or more than one thing: a clean towel, clean towels, the towel is clean, the towels are clean.
item.contrast_text: The green key is on the hook. Here, green comes before key and helps you find the right key. The key is green. Here, green comes after is and tells you the color of the key.
item.common_error_pattern: Putting the adjective after the noun inside a noun phrase, leaving out am, is, or are before a describing adjective, or adding -s to an adjective with a plural noun.

examples.bad: The key blue is for the spare room.
examples.good: The blue key is for the spare room.

children.title: Find the right room
children.instructions: Finish the sign for the yellow door. Put yellow directly before door. Write the missing word only.

children.title: Report on the bed
children.instructions: Say the bed is dry. Put dry directly after is. Write the missing word only.

children.title: Offer a box
children.instructions: Offer a box with nothing in it. Use an and empty, in that order, before box. Write the missing words only.
children.prompt_text: I have ___ box for your things.

children.title: Mark the cups
children.instructions: Label the cups that guests can use. Put white directly before cups and keep its usual form. Write the missing word only.

children.title: Reply about the key
children.instructions: The host is waiting to give you the key. Complete your reply with the full form of be and the word ready. Write the missing words only.

children.title: Fix the shelf label
children.instructions: Rewrite the whole label. Move small directly before shelf. Keep all the other words.
children.prompt_text: The shelf small is for bags.
accepted_answers: The small shelf is for bags.

children.title: Fix the towel update
children.instructions: Rewrite the whole update. Correct the form of clean and keep it after are. Keep all the other words.

children.title: Describe the rug
children.instructions: Turn the note into a full sentence. Start with The rug and put red after is.

children.title: Write a short lamp label
children.instructions: Make a label of exactly three words. Start with a or an and put old directly before lamp. Choose the article that fits the sound at the start of old.

children.title: Report on both windows
children.instructions: Rewrite the note so it describes both windows. Start with The windows and put open after the correct form of be.

children.title: Say which chair is free
children.instructions: Use each tile once to tell a guest which chair is free. Start with The. Put big before chair and free after is. Add a period.

children.title: Say which sheets are ready
children.instructions: Use each tile once to tell a guest which sheets are ready. Start with The. Put blue before sheets and ready after are. Add a period.
